summary: Row (6) is a catastrophic-if-violated source (file header: 'catastrophic-if-violated invariants + doc pointers only'). Same row also says 'absent in BOTH views is the only zero-row supported' while a present-and-empty Installation key is also supported/zero rows (WinRegFs ok with zero names). Fix either the row text (scope loudness to FilePath, add present-and-empty) or the code (a token when every candidate's VRMF is absent); needs a non-author ruling because it touches a routed invariant. Prior gates raised this as code-review Q1/Q2 and adversarial M3 without a ruling.

trigger: FilePath read on a registered installation fails with a registry error that is neither not-found nor access-denied (RegOpenKeyExW/RegQueryValueExW other error, value grows or vanishes between the two queries) while a sibling installation is readable
policy_floor: Routed-concern row (middleware) clause (6): 'only an absent, empty, oversized or wrong-type FilePath is a logged data-shape drop' - a failed (I/O) read is not in that list but is dropped
summary: RegStatus::failed conflates a wrong-type value (decide_value other -> failed, middleware_win_parsers.hpp:~85) with a genuine read failure (middleware_win.cpp:38-51,96,103-118). run_reg_leg treats every non-denied non-ok FilePath as a data-shape drop: with healthy siblings the answer is supported minus that installation, and the installed-software sync then treats the section as complete. Same finding as adversarial M2 (graded LOW there); the derivation gives I3/E5 = HIGH and the row text makes it a floor. Fix: separate wrong-type from failed (or map failed FilePath to a constraining token like denied), update the pin at tests/unit/test_middleware_parsers.cpp:~1613.

reviewed_at_sha: 6aae12e3da (merge-base with origin/dev 0c68ac5043; branch is 46 commits behind origin/dev)
trigger: HKLM\SOFTWARE\IBM\WebSphere MQ\Installation holds tens of thousands of subkeys (planted or corrupt; HKLM write needs admin)
summary: WinRegFs::reg_subkeys de-duplicates with std::none_of over the growing result vector: O(n^2) iequals_ascii calls before the runner's kMaxRows (256) cut. Measured on this host (clang -O2, arm64, names 'Installation<i>'): 5,000 names 0.30 s, 16,000 names 1.64 s, 65,000 names (the kMaxRegEntries budget) 101.7 s. The entries budget therefore does not bound the work it claims to (row (3): bounded in entries visited); the 60 s sync worker is abandoned and keeps burning a core, a direct dispatch blocks its thread. Fix: lowercase-key unordered_set or sort+unique, plus a test at the budget.
